card.fires_on: Fires on the word or word-part that comes right before a drug name, a dosage form, or a cross-reference such as Administration. It is typically a piece of a brand name (J|ARDIANCE, F|ETZIMA) or of a word like ophthalmic.

modes.label: Start of brand name
modes.description: The first letter or piece of an upper-case brand name after verbs like discontinue or starting.

modes.label: Dosage and Administration reference
modes.description: The word Administration (or a piece of it) inside a section cross-reference such as [see Dosage and Administration].

modes.label: Start of ophthalmic
modes.description: The opening piece of ophthalmic after a drug name.
